-- A tokenizer and recursive-descent parser for arithmetic, with variables and errors.

local function tokenize(source)
	local tokens = {}
	local i = 1
	while i <= #source do
		local c = source:sub(i, i)
		if c:match("%s") then
			i += 1
		elseif c:match("%d") then
			local number = source:match("^%d+%.?%d*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "number", value = tonumber(number) })
			i += #number
		elseif c:match("[%a_]") then
			local name = source:match("^[%a_][%w_]*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "name", value = name })
			i += #name
		elseif c:match("[%+%-%*/%^%(%)=]") then
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = c })
			i += 1
		else
			error(`unexpected character '{c}' at {i}`, 0)
		end
	end
	table.insert(tokens, { kind = "end" })
	return tokens
end

local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser

function Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	return setmetatable({ tokens = tokens, pos = 1, variables = variables }, Parser)
end

function Parser:peek()
	return self.tokens[self.pos].kind
end

function Parser:take(kind)
	local token = self.tokens[self.pos]
	if kind and token.kind ~= kind then
		error(`expected {kind}, got {token.kind}`, 0)
	end
	self.pos += 1
	return token
end

local PRECEDENCE = { ["+"] = 1, ["-"] = 1, ["*"] = 2, ["/"] = 2, ["^"] = 3 }

function Parser:primary()
	local token = self:take()
	if token.kind == "number" then
		return token.value
	elseif token.kind == "name" then
		local value = self.variables[token.value]
		if value == nil then
			error(`unknown variable {token.value}`, 0)
		end
		return value
	elseif token.kind == "-" then
		return -self:expression(3)
	elseif token.kind == "(" then
		local value = self:expression(0)
		self:take(")")
		return value
	end
	error(`unexpected {token.kind}`, 0)
end

function Parser:expression(minimum)
	local left = self:primary()
	while true do
		local op = self:peek()
		local precedence = PRECEDENCE[op]
		if not precedence or precedence <= minimum and op ~= "^" or precedence < minimum then
			return left
		end
		self:take()
		local right = self:expression(op == "^" and precedence - 1 or precedence)
		if op == "+" then
			left += right
		elseif op == "-" then
			left -= right
		elseif op == "*" then
			left *= right
		elseif op == "/" then
			if right == 0 then
				error("division by zero", 0)
			end
			left /= right
		else
			left ^= right
		end
	end
end

local function run(line, variables)
	local tokens = tokenize(line)
	local target
	if tokens[2].kind == "=" then
		target = tokens[1].value
		table.remove(tokens, 1)
		table.remove(tokens, 1)
	end
	local parser = Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	local value = parser:expression(0)
	parser:take("end")
	if target then
		variables[target] = value
	end
	return value
end

local variables = { pi = math.pi }
for _, line in { "x = 2 + 3 * 4", "y = (x - 4) ^ 2 / 2", "x * y - -3", "r = 2", "pi * r ^ 2", "1 / (x - 14)", "z + 1", "3 $ 4" } do
	local ok, result = pcall(run, line, variables)
	print(line, "=>", if ok then string.format("%.4g", result) else `error: {result}`)
end

-- upvalues, nested closures and recursion
local function makeCounter(start, step)
	local value = start
	return function()
		value += step
		return value
	end, function()
		value = start
	end
end

local next, reset = makeCounter(10, 5)
print(next(), next())
reset()
print(next())

local function memoize(fn)
	local cache = {}
	return function(n)
		local hit = cache[n]
		if hit == nil then
			hit = fn(n)
			cache[n] = hit
		end
		return hit
	end
end

local fib
fib = memoize(function(n)
	if n < 2 then
		return n
	end
	return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
end)
print(fib(40))

local handlers = {}
for i = 1, 3 do
	handlers[i] = function(x)
		return x * i
	end
end
print(handlers[2](21))

-- branches and every loop kind
local function classify(n)
	if n < 0 then
		return "negative"
	elseif n == 0 then
		return "zero"
	elseif n % 2 == 0 then
		return "even"
	else
		return "odd"
	end
end

local function sumUntil(limit)
	local total, i = 0, 1
	while total < limit do
		total += i
		i += 1
	end
	return total, i
end

local function firstPrimeAfter(n)
	local candidate = n
	repeat
		candidate += 1
		local prime = candidate > 1
		for d = 2, math.floor(math.sqrt(candidate)) do
			if candidate % d == 0 then
				prime = false
				break
			end
		end
	until prime
	return candidate
end

local counts = {}
for _, word in ipairs({ "a", "b", "a", "c", "b", "a" }) do
	if word == "c" then
		continue
	end
	counts[word] = (counts[word] or 0) + 1
end

for key, value in pairs(counts) do
	print(key, value, classify(value))
end

for i = 10, 1, -3 do
	print(i, sumUntil(i), firstPrimeAfter(i))
end

-- compiled with debug level 2, so the real local names are in the bytecode
local function distance(ax, ay, bx, by)
	local dx = bx - ax
	local dy = by - ay
	return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
end

local waypoints = { { 0, 0 }, { 3, 4 }, { 6, 8 } }
local travelled = 0
for index = 2, #waypoints do
	local previous = waypoints[index - 1]
	local current = waypoints[index]
	travelled += distance(previous[1], previous[2], current[1], current[2])
end
print(travelled)

entries.source:
-- evaluation order a decompiler can't move: locals used once whose calls have side effects,
-- the operands of > and >= (compiled as < and <= with the operands swapped), a method call's
-- object and arguments, and values read before a later write or call changes them
local trace = {}
local function note(tag, value)
	table.insert(trace, tag)
	return value
end
local function flush(label)
	print(label, table.concat(trace, " "))
	table.clear(trace)
end

-- two locals used once each, in the opposite order: inlining both would swap the calls
local first = note("a", 1)
local second = note("b", 2)
print(second, first)
flush("locals")

-- > and >= compile to LT and LE with the operands swapped, but they still run left to right
print(note("l", 3) > note("r", 2), note("l", 1) >= note("r", 1), note("l", "x") < note("r", "y"))
flush("compare")
print(not (note("l", 1) <= note("r", 2)), note("l", 2) ~= note("r", 2))
flush("compare not")
if note("cond l", 5) > note("cond r", 4) then
	note("then", nil)
end
flush("branch")

-- the object of a method call is worked out once, before its arguments
local obj = { n = 0 }
function obj:add(k)
	self.n += k
	return self
end
local function getobj()
	note("obj", nil)
	return obj
end
getobj():add(note("arg", 1)):add(note("arg2", 2))
print(obj.n)
flush("method")

-- a value read into a local before the table changes keeps the old value
local t = { v = "old" }
local saved = t.v
t.v = "new"
print(saved, t.v)
local box = { 1, 2, 3 }
local len = #box
table.insert(box, 4)
print(len, #box)

-- a call that changes a local the same argument list reads before and after it
local counter = 0
local function bump()
	counter += 1
	return counter
end
print(counter, bump(), counter + 0, bump())
local before = counter
bump()
print(before, counter)

-- an index read before a call in the same expression moves it
local arr = { 10, 20, 30 }
local i = 1
local function advance()
	i += 1
	return 0
end
print(arr[i] + advance(), arr[i])

-- every operand runs left to right before anything combines, right-associative or not
print(note("1", "a") .. note("2", "b") .. note("3", "c"))
flush("concat")
print(note("x", 2) ^ note("y", 3) ^ note("z", 1), note("p", 10) - note("q", 3) - note("r", 2))
flush("arith")

-- and / or only run what they need
local hit = note("left", false) and note("never", true) or note("right", "ok")
print(hit)
flush("logic")

-- a constructor evaluates its entries in order, keyed or not
local made = { note("one", 1), k = note("key", 2), note("two", 3), [note("ikey", "x")] = note("ival", 4) }
print(made[1], made[2], made.k, made.x)
flush("constructor")

-- an assignment reads its target table before the right-hand side runs, so a call that replaces
-- the table writes into the old one
local holder = { inner = { v = 0 } }
local function swap()
	note("swap", nil)
	local old = holder.inner
	holder.inner = { v = 100 }
	return old.v + 1
end
holder.inner.v = swap()
print(holder.inner.v)
flush("target")

-- event handlers and loops over instance collections
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local function onCharacter(character)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		print(character.Name, "died")
	end)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	print("joined", player.Name, player.UserId)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	player.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
		if message == "/reset" and player.Character then
			player.Character:BreakJoints()
		end
	end)
end)

workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
	if child:IsA("BasePart") then
		child.Anchored = true
	end
end)

local pad = workspace:WaitForChild("Pad")
pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
	local owner = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
	if owner then
		print(owner.Name, "touched the pad")
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
		print("interact")
	end
end)

local elapsed = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
	elapsed += deltaTime
end)

for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
	print(child.Name)
end

for _, descendant in workspace:GetDescendants() do
	if descendant:IsA("Light") then
		descendant.Enabled = false
	end
end

for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	print(player.DisplayName, elapsed)
end

-- generic for without an iterator function: plain tables (array part, then hash part), __iter
-- returning a closure or next, objects with __call, coroutines, and pairs and ipairs, which the
-- compiler turns into their own loop instructions
local function keys(t)
	local out = {}
	for k in t do
		table.insert(out, tostring(k))
	end
	table.sort(out)
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

local list = { "a", "b", "c" }
for i, v in list do
	print("plain", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs(list) do
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end
for i, v in pairs(list) do
	print("pairs", i, v)
end
print(keys({ x = 1, y = 2, [3] = true, [true] = 0 }))

-- a hole: ipairs stops at it, a plain loop and pairs walk past it
local holes = { 1, 2, nil, 4 }
local viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs = 0, 0, 0
for _ in ipairs(holes) do
	viaIpairs += 1
end
for _ in holes do
	viaPlain += 1
end
for _ in pairs(holes) do
	viaPairs += 1
end
print(viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs)

-- __iter returning a stateful closure
local Range = {}
Range.__index = Range
Range.__iter = function(self)
	local i = self.from - self.step
	return function()
		i += self.step
		if i <= self.to then
			return i, i * i
		end
		return nil
	end
end
local function range(from, to, step)
	return setmetatable({ from = from, to = to, step = step or 1 }, Range)
end
for v, sq in range(1, 7, 3) do
	print("range", v, sq)
end

-- __iter handing back next and another table to walk
local Bag = {
	__iter = function(self)
		return next, self.items
	end,
}
local bag = setmetatable({ items = { "x", "y" }, hidden = true }, Bag)
for k, v in bag do
	print("bag", k, v)
end

-- an object with __call is the iterator function itself
local countdown = setmetatable({ n = 3 }, {
	__call = function(self)
		if self.n > 0 then
			self.n -= 1
			return self.n + 1
		end
		return nil
	end,
})
for v in countdown do
	print("countdown", v)
end

-- a coroutine as the iterator
for v in coroutine.wrap(function()
	for i = 1, 3 do
		coroutine.yield(i * 2)
	end
end) do
	print("co", v)
end

-- continue, break and writing the loop variable inside generalized loops
for i, v in list do
	if v == "b" then
		continue
	end
	i *= 10
	print("skip b", i, v)
end
local found
for i, v in { 5, 6, 7, 8 } do
	if v % 2 == 1 and i > 1 then
		found = i
		break
	end
end
print("found", found)

-- nested loops over the same table, the inner one reading the outer's variables
local grid = { { 1, 2 }, { 3, 4 } }
local sum = 0
for r, row in grid do
	for c, cell in row do
		sum += cell * r * c
	end
end
print("grid", sum)

-- a table changed between loops is walked as it is now
local growing = { 1 }
for round = 1, 3 do
	local seen = 0
	for _ in growing do
		seen += 1
	end
	growing[#growing + 1] = round
	print("round", round, seen)
end

entries.source:
-- small local functions that -O2 copies into their callers
local log = {}

local function tap(tag, value)
	table.insert(log, tag)
	return value
end

local function clamp(x, lo, hi)
	if x < lo then
		return lo
	elseif x > hi then
		return hi
	end
	return x
end

local function guard(value)
	if not value then
		return
	end
	table.insert(log, "guarded " .. tostring(value))
end

local counter = 0
local function bump(by)
	counter += by
end

local sum = tap("l", 1) + tap("r", 2) * tap("m", 3)
local short = tap("p", false) and tap("q", 1) or tap("z", 2)
local tbl = {}
tbl[tap("ck", "count")] = (tbl.count or 0) + tap("cv", 1)

for i = -2, 12, 5 do
	print(i, clamp(i, 0, 10))
	bump(i)
end

guard(nil)
guard("yes")

local function scaled(n)
	return clamp(n * 2, 1, 9)
end

if clamp(sum, 0, 5) == 5 and scaled(3) > 4 then
	print("both")
end

while counter > 0 do
	counter -= clamp(counter, 1, 7)
	if counter % 3 == 0 then
		break
	end
end

print(sum, short, tbl.count, counter, table.concat(log, ","))

--!strict
-- An inventory with stacking, weight limits and a sorted report.

local Inventory = {}
Inventory.__index = Inventory

local ITEMS = {
	sword = { weight = 8, stack = 1, value = 120 },
	potion = { weight = 1, stack = 10, value = 25 },
	arrow = { weight = 0.1, stack = 64, value = 1 },
	shield = { weight = 12, stack = 1, value = 90 },
}

function Inventory.new(capacity)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Inventory)
	self.capacity = capacity
	self.slots = {}
	self.weight = 0
	return self
end

local function round(n, places)
	local scale = 10 ^ places
	return math.floor(n * scale + 0.5) / scale
end

function Inventory:add(name, count)
	local info = ITEMS[name]
	if not info then
		return false, `unknown item {name}`
	end
	if self.weight + info.weight * count > self.capacity then
		return false, `too heavy: {round(self.weight + info.weight * count, 1)} > {self.capacity}`
	end
	local left = count
	for _, slot in self.slots do
		if slot.name == name and slot.count < info.stack then
			local moved = math.min(info.stack - slot.count, left)
			slot.count += moved
			left -= moved
			if left == 0 then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	while left > 0 do
		local moved = math.min(info.stack, left)
		table.insert(self.slots, { name = name, count = moved })
		left -= moved
	end
	self.weight += info.weight * count
	return true
end

function Inventory:remove(name, count)
	for i = #self.slots, 1, -1 do
		local slot = self.slots[i]
		if slot.name ~= name then
			continue
		end
		local taken = math.min(slot.count, count)
		slot.count -= taken
		count -= taken
		self.weight -= ITEMS[name].weight * taken
		if slot.count == 0 then
			table.remove(self.slots, i)
		end
		if count == 0 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return count == 0
end

function Inventory:report()
	local totals = {}
	for _, slot in self.slots do
		totals[slot.name] = (totals[slot.name] or 0) + slot.count
	end
	local names = {}
	for name in totals do
		table.insert(names, name)
	end
	table.sort(names, function(a, b)
		return ITEMS[a].value * totals[a] > ITEMS[b].value * totals[b]

-- for loops: generic for over custom iterators (stateless, stateful, next directly), numeric for
-- with float and negative steps, bounds evaluated once, and a body that writes its loop variable
local function range(n)
	local i = 0
	return function()
		i += 1
		if i <= n then
			return i, i * i
		end
	end
end
for i, sq in range(3) do
	print("range", i, sq)
end

local function evens(t, i)
	i += 2
	if t[i] ~= nil then
		return i, t[i]
	end
end
local list = { "a", "b", "c", "d", "e" }
for i, v in evens, list, -1 do
	print("evens", i, v)
end

local sorted = { 10, 20, 30 }
for i, v in next, sorted do
	print("next", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs({ 1, 2, nil, 4 }) do
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end

for i = 1, 2, 0.5 do
	print("float", i)
end
for i = 3, 1, -1 do
	print("down", i)
end
for i = 1, 0 do
	print("never", i)
end
for i = 1.0, 3 do
	print("float start", i)
end

local calls = 0
local function bound(v)
	calls += 1
	return v
end
for i = bound(1), bound(3), bound(1) do
	print("bounded", i)
end
print("bound calls", calls)

-- writing the loop variable changes only this iteration's copy
for i = 1, 3 do
	local before = i
	i = i * 10
	print("copy", before, i)
end

-- a while loop with two exits and a repeat that runs once
local n, steps = 27, 0
while true do
	if n == 1 then
		break
	end
	if steps > 200 then
		print("too long")
		break
	end
	n = if n % 2 == 0 then n // 2 else 3 * n + 1
	steps += 1
end
print("collatz", steps)
repeat
	steps -= 1
until true
print("after repeat", steps)

-- nested loops where the inner break and continue only touch the inner loop
local found = {}
for i = 1, 4 do
	for j = 1, 4 do
		if j > i then
			break
		end
		if (i + j) % 2 == 1 then
			continue
		end
		found[#found + 1] = i * 10 + j
	end
end
print(table.concat(found, " "))

-- literals that have to come back exactly: escapes, control bytes, long brackets that contain
-- their own closers, numbers at the edges of what %.17g and hex can say, and -0
print("tab\there", "nl\\n", "quote\"s", 'single\'s', "bell\a", "nul[\0]", "del\127", "hi\255\128")
print(#"\0\0\0", ("\0x"):byte(1, -1))
print("\u{48}\u{E9}\u{1F600}", #"\u{1F600}")
print("\x41\x42", "\65\066\0671", "line1\
line2")
print([[long ]] .. [==[with ]] and ]=] inside]==], [[
leading newline dropped]])
print(`interp {1 + 1} \{not} {"{}"}`)

local nums = {
	0, -0, 1 / -math.huge, 0.1, 0.1 + 0.2, 1e-310, 5e-324, 1.7976931348623157e308,
	2 ^ 53, 2 ^ 53 + 1, 9007199254740993, 0x7fffffff, 0xffffffffffff, 0x10, 1e15, 1e16,
	123456789012345678, 3.14159265358979, 1 / 3, -1 / 3, 100, 1e2, 0.5e1,
}
for i, n in ipairs(nums) do
	print(i, n, string.format("%.17g", n), 1 / n == math.huge, 1 / n == -math.huge)
end

-- -0 survives arithmetic only if the constant does
local z = -0
print(1 / z, 1 / (z * 1), 1 / (0 * -1), math.max(-0, 0), tostring(-0.0))

-- strings that look like other things
local keys = { "end", "nil", "1", "a b", "", "\n", "x.y", "__index" }
local t = {}
for i, k in ipairs(keys) do
	t[k] = i
end
for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
	print(string.format("%q", k), t[k])
end
print(t["end"], t["nil"], t["1"], t[1])

-- closures made in loops: each iteration of a for loop has its own variable, a while loop's
-- local is fresh each time round, and an upvalue written after capture is shared
local fns = {}
for i = 1, 3 do
	fns[#fns + 1] = function()
		return i
	end
end
local k = 0
while k < 3 do
	k += 1
	local j = k * 10
	fns[#fns + 1] = function()
		return j
	end
end
for _, v in ipairs({ "a", "b" }) do
	local copy = v
	fns[#fns + 1] = function()
		copy = copy .. "!"
		return copy
	end
end
for idx, f in ipairs(fns) do
	print(idx, f(), f())
end

-- one variable captured by two closures, then changed from outside
local function counter()
	local n = 0
	local function inc()
		n += 1
		return n
	end
	local function get()
		return n
	end
	n = 100
	return inc, get
end
local inc, get = counter()
inc()
print(get(), inc(), get())

-- a loop variable shadowed inside the body, and the outer one read after
local total = 0
for i = 1, 4 do
	local i = i * 2
	total += i
end
local i = "outer"
print(total, i)

-- the loop body's local captured, then the loop exits early
local saved
for n = 1, 10 do
	local sq = n * n
	if sq > 20 then
		saved = function()
			return sq
		end
		break
	end
end
print(saved())

-- repeat whose condition reads a local from the body, captured by a closure there
local seen = {}
local r = 0
repeat
	r += 1
	local stop = r >= 3
	seen[r] = function()
		return stop
	end
until stop
print(r, seen[1](), seen[3]())

-- loops whose exits carry a value out, and a loop body that needs a goto to structure
do
	local Entry = {get = function() return {[2] = {seen = true}} end}
	local function seen(id)
		local e = Entry.get()[id]
		return e ~= nil and e.seen ~= nil
	end
	local function pick(tips)
		local index = nil
		for i, tip in tips do
			if tip.show and not seen(tip.id) then
				index = i
				break
			end
		end
		if index == nil then
			return false
		end
		local ok, v = pcall(function()
			return tips[index].id * 100
		end)
		return ok, v
	end
	print(pick({{show = false, id = 1}, {show = true, id = 2}, {show = true, id = 3}, {show = true, id = 4}}))
	print(pick({{show = true, id = 2}}))
end
do
	local function nextShown(tips, from)
		local index = nil
		for i = from + 1, #tips do
			if tips[i].toShow then
				index = i
				break
			end
		end
		if index ~= nil then
			return "show " .. index .. " " .. tips[index].id
		end
		return "none"
	end
	local tips = {{toShow = true, id = "a"}, {toShow = false, id = "b"}, {toShow = true, id = "c"}}
	print(nextShown(tips, 0), nextShown(tips, 1), nextShown(tips, 3))
end
do
	local function findKey(t, want)
		local key = nil
		for k, v in t do
			if v == want then
				key = k
				break
			end
		end
		if key ~= nil then
			return "found " .. key
		end
		return "none"
	end
	print(findKey({"x", "y", "z"}, "y"), findKey({"x"}, "q"))
end
do
	local function conv(list)
		local out = {}
		for _, v in list do
			if typeof(v) ~= "number" then
				v = tonumber(v) or -1
			end
			table.insert(out, v * 2)
		end
		return table.concat(out, ",")
	end
	local function conv2(n)
		local out = {}
		for i = 1, n do
			if i % 2 == 0 then
				i = i * 100
			end
			table.insert(out, i)
		end
		return table.concat(out, ",")
	end
	print(conv({1, "2", "x", 4}), conv2(4))
end
do
	local function m(items, opts)
		local res = {}
		for _, it in items do
			if it.name then
				local n = it.name
				if opts and opts.skip and opts.skip[n .. "*"] then
					res[n] = "skip*"
				elseif opts and opts.skip and opts.skip[n] then
					res[n] = "skip"
				else
					local k = it.kind
					if k == 1 then
						res[n] = "one"
					elseif k == 2 then
						res[n] = "two"
					else
						if k ~= 3 then
							continue
						end
						res[n] = "three"
					end
				end
			else
				if it.kind ~= 9 then
					continue
				end
				res.schema = "s"
			end
		end
		local keys = {}
		for k, v in res do table.insert(keys, k .. "=" .. v) end
		table.sort(keys)
		return table.concat(keys, ",")
	end
	local items = {{name = "a", kind = 1}, {name = "b", kind = 2}, {name = "c", kind = 3}, {name = "d", kind = 4}, {kind = 9}, {name = "e", kind = 1}, {name = "f", kind = 1}}
	print(m(items, nil))
	print(m(items, {skip = {["a*"] = true, b = true}}))
	print(m(items, {}))
end

-- breaks, continues and returns out of loops, each checked by running both versions
do
	local function find(t, x)
		local found = nil
		for i, v in t do
			if v == x then
				found = i
				break
			end
		end
		if found == nil then
			return "none"
		end
		return found
	end
	print(find({1, 5, 3, 5}, 5), find({1, 2}, 9), find({}, 1))
end
do
	local function first_even(n)
		local r
		for i = 1, n do
			if i % 2 == 0 and i > 3 then
				r = i
				break
			end
		end
		return r
	end
	print(first_even(10), first_even(3))
end
do
	local function f(a, t)
		local hit = 0
		if a then
			for _, v in t do
				if v > 2 then
					hit = v
					break
				end
			end
		else
			hit = -1
		end
		return hit * 10
	end
	print(f(true, {1, 3, 4}), f(true, {1}), f(false, {9}))
end
do
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		for j = 1, 4 do
			if j > i then
				break
			end
			if (i + j) % 2 == 1 then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(out, i * 10 + j)
		end
		if i == 3 then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, -i)
	end
	print(table.concat(out, ","))
end
do
	local function g(n)
		local i, s = 0, 0
		while i < n do
			i += 1
			if i % 3 == 0 then
				continue
			end
			if s > 20 then
				break
			end
			s += i
		end
		return i, s
	end
	print(g(5), g(100))
end
do
	local function h(n)
		local i, acc = 0, {}
		repeat
			i += 1
			if i == 2 then
				continue
			end
			table.insert(acc, i)
		until i >= n
		return table.concat(acc, " ")
	end
	print(h(5), h(1))
end
do
	local function any_neg(t)
		for _, row in t do
			for _, v in row do
				if v < 0 then
					return true, v
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end
	print(any_neg({{1, 2}, {3, -4, -5}}), any_neg({{1}}))
end
do
	local fs = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local j = i * 2
		if i == 2 then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(fs, function() return i + j end)
	end
	local r = {}
	for _, f in fs do table.insert(r, f()) end
	print(table.concat(r, ","))
end
do
	local function f(list, flag)
		local n = 0
		for _, v in list do
			n += 1
			if v > 10 then
				if flag then
					print("big flag", v)
					return n
				else
					print("big", v)
					return -n
				end
			end
		end
		return 0
	end
	local function g(list)
		for _, v in list do
			if v == 1 then
				print("one")
				return
			elseif v == 2 then
				print("two")
				return
			end
			print("other", v)
		end
		print("end")
	end
	print(f({1, 2, 30, 40}, true), f({1, 50}, false), f({1}, true))
	g({5, 2, 1}) g({5, 6})
end

-- metamethods: arithmetic, comparison, concat, call, index and newindex functions, len and unm,
-- and the raw functions that skip them
local Vec = {}
Vec.__index = Vec
local function vec(x, y)
	return setmetatable({ x = x, y = y }, Vec)
end
Vec.__add = function(a, b)
	return vec(a.x + b.x, a.y + b.y)
end
Vec.__sub = function(a, b)
	return vec(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y)
end
Vec.__mul = function(a, b)
	if type(a) == "number" then
		return vec(a * b.x, a * b.y)
	end
	return vec(a.x * b, a.y * b)
end
Vec.__unm = function(a)
	return vec(-a.x, -a.y)
end
Vec.__eq = function(a, b)
	return a.x == b.x and a.y == b.y
end
Vec.__lt = function(a, b)
	return a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y < b.x * b.x + b.y * b.y
end
Vec.__le = function(a, b)
	return not (b < a)
end
Vec.__len = function(a)
	return math.sqrt(a.x * a.x + a.y * a.y)
end
Vec.__concat = function(a, b)
	local function s(v)
		return if type(v) == "table" then `({v.x}, {v.y})` else tostring(v)
	end
	return s(a) .. s(b)
end
Vec.__call = function(self, k)
	return self[k]
end
function Vec:dot(o)
	return self.x * o.x + self.y * o.y
end

local a, b = vec(1, 2), vec(3, 4)
local c = a + b
print(c.x, c.y, (a - b).x, (2 * a).y, (a * 3).x, (-a).x)
print(a == vec(1, 2), a ~= b, a < b, a <= b, a > b, b >= a, rawequal(a, vec(1, 2)))
print(#b, a .. b, a .. "!", "v=" .. a, a("y"), a:dot(b), Vec.dot(a, b))

-- __index and __newindex as functions, logging every access
local log = {}
local store = {}
local proxy = setmetatable({}, {
	__index = function(_, k)
		log[#log + 1] = "get " .. tostring(k)
		return store[k]
	end,
	__newindex = function(_, k, v)
		log[#log + 1] = "set " .. tostring(k)
		store[k] = v
	end,
})
proxy.a = 1
proxy.a += 1
proxy[1] = proxy.a * 10
print(proxy.a, proxy[1], rawget(proxy, "a"), table.concat(log, ","))
rawset(proxy, "raw", true)
print(proxy.raw, #log)

-- inheritance through __index chains
local Base = {}
Base.__index = Base
function Base.new(name)
	return setmetatable({ name = name }, Base)
end
function Base:hello()
	return "base " .. self.name
end
local Derived = setmetatable({}, { __index = Base })
Derived.__index = Derived
function Derived.new(name)
	local self = Base.new(name)
	return setmetatable(self, Derived)
end
function Derived:hello()
	return "derived " .. Base.hello(self)
end
local d = Derived.new("d")
print(d:hello(), getmetatable(d) == Derived, Base.hello(d))

entries.source:
-- multiple assignment and multiple returns: every right-hand side is read before anything is
-- assigned, a call in the middle of a list is cut to one value, and parentheses cut it too
local function three()
	return 1, 2, 3
end
local function none() end

local a, b, c = 1, 2, 3
a, b, c = c, a, b
print(a, b, c)

local t = { 10, 20, 30 }
local i = 1
i, t[i] = i + 1, "x" -- the index is read before i changes
print(i, t[1], t[2])

local x, y, z = three(), 10
print(x, y, z)
print((three()))
print(three(), three())
print(#{ three(), three() }, #{ (three()), three() }, select("#", none()), select("#", (none())))

local function count(...)
	return select("#", ...)
end
print(count(nil, nil), count(none()), count(none(), nil), count(three()))

local function tail(...)
	local first, rest = ..., select(2, ...)
	return first, rest, select(-1, ...)
end
print(tail(4, 5, 6))

-- a swap through a table and a local in one statement
local cell = { v = 1 }
local held = 2
cell.v, held = held, cell.v
print(cell.v, held)

-- varargs captured into a table with holes
local function pack(...)
	return { n = select("#", ...), ... }
end
local p = pack(1, nil, 3, nil)
print(p.n, p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4])

-- assignment to a local that a later expression in the same list reads
local m = 1
local n
m, n = m + 1, m
print(m, n)

-- compound assignment whose index expression has a side effect, evaluated once
local calls = 0
local function idx()
	calls += 1
	return 2
end
local arr = { 1, 2, 3 }
arr[idx()] += 10
arr[idx()] ..= ""
print(arr[2], calls)

-- comparisons a decompiler can't flip: with NaN, `not (a < b)` isn't `a >= b`, and `x ~= x` is
-- true. Also and/or chains where a false or nil value in the middle changes which side wins
local nan = 0 / 0
local values = { 1, -1, 0, nan, math.huge, -math.huge }

local function compare(a, b)
	local out = {}
	if not (a < b) then out[#out + 1] = "!lt" end
	if not (a <= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!le" end
	if not (a > b) then out[#out + 1] = "!gt" end
	if not (a >= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!ge" end
	if a ~= a then out[#out + 1] = "self" end
	if not (a == b) then out[#out + 1] = "!eq" end
	while not (a < b) do
		out[#out + 1] = "w"
		break
	end
	local rounds = 0
	repeat
		rounds += 1
		out[#out + 1] = "r"
	until not (a > b) or rounds == 2
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

for i = 1, #values do
	for j = 1, #values do
		print(i, j, compare(values[i], values[j]))
	end
end

-- values, not just truthiness
local function pick(a, b, c)
	local x = a and b or c
	local y = a and (b or c)
	local z = (a or b) and c
	local w = not a == not b
	local v = a and false or c
	local u = a == nil and b or nil
	return x, y, z, w, v, u
end
local samples = { true, false, nil, 0, "", nan }
for i = 1, 6 do
	for j = 1, 6 do
		for k = 1, 6 do
			local a, b, c = samples[i], samples[j], samples[k]
			print(i, j, k, pick(a, b, c))
		end
	end
end

-- a guard whose branches both fall through, around a comparison with a constant on the left
local count = 0
for _, v in ipairs(values) do
	if 0 < v then
		count += 1
	elseif not (0 >= v) then
		count += 100
	end
end
print("count", count)

-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

-- constants the compiler folds, and the places folding differs from running
local base = 3
local exponent = 0.5
local half = 2 ^ exponent
local cube = base ^ 3
local square = base ^ 2
local huge = math.huge
local nan = 0 / 0

local function power(b, e)
	return b ^ e
end

print(half, cube, square, power(base, 3), power(2, exponent))
print(huge, -huge, nan ~= nan, 1 / -huge)
print(7 // 2, -7 // 2, 7 % -3, 2 ^ -1)
print(0x10, 1e3, 1.5e-3, 123456789012)

local acc = 1
for i = 1, 5 do
	acc *= i
	acc += 0.5
end
print(acc)

local message = `{base} cubed is {cube}, {#"four"} letters`
print(message)

-- metatable classes with methods
local Account = {}
Account.__index = Account

function Account.new(owner, balance)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Account)
	self.owner = owner
	self.balance = balance or 0
	self.history = {}
	return self
end

function Account:deposit(amount)
	if amount <= 0 then
		error("deposit must be positive")
	end
	self.balance += amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "deposit", amount = amount })
end

function Account:withdraw(amount)
	if amount > self.balance then
		return false, "insufficient funds"
	end
	self.balance -= amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "withdraw", amount = amount })
	return true
end

function Account:statement()
	local lines = {}
	for index, entry in ipairs(self.history) do
		lines[index] = ("%s %d"):format(entry.kind, entry.amount)
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local savings = Account.new("sam", 100)
savings:deposit(50)
local ok, reason = savings:withdraw(500)
if not ok then
	print(reason)
end
print(savings:statement())

-- precedence and arithmetic corners a printer has to parenthesize or keep apart: unary minus
-- against ^, not against ==, right-associative .. and ^, and Luau's floor division and modulo with
-- negative and fractional operands
local values = { 7, -7, 2.5, -2.5, 0.5, 3 }
for _, a in ipairs(values) do
	for _, b in ipairs({ 2, -2, 0.5, 3 }) do
		print(a, b, a // b, a % b, a / b, -a ^ b == -(a ^ b), (-a) ^ 2, a - -b)
	end
end

local x, y = 2, 3
print(-x ^ 2, (-x) ^ 2, 2 ^ -1, 2 ^ 3 ^ 2, (2 ^ 3) ^ 2)
print(not x == y, not (x == y), not not x, - -x, -(-x))
print(1 .. 2, 1 .. 2 .. 3, "a" .. 1 + 2, ("a" .. 1) .. 2)
print(x < y == true, (x < y) == true, x + y * 2, (x + y) * 2, x * y % 4, x * (y % 4))
print(#"abc" + 1, #{ 1, 2 } * 2, -#"ab", #("a" .. "bc"))
print(7 // 0, -7 // 0, 0 / 0 ~= 0 / 0, -7 % math.huge, 7 % -math.huge)
print(2 ^ 53 + 1, 2 ^ 63, -2 ^ 63, 1e308 * 10, -1e308 * 10)

-- the same expressions on values the compiler can't fold
local function id(v)
	return v
end
local p, q = id(-7), id(2)
print(p // q, p % q, -p ^ q, (p .. q), p < q and "lt" or "ge", not (p < q))

-- comparisons the printer might swap or merge
local function order(a, b)
	return a < b, a > b, b < a, a <= b, not (a > b), a == b, a ~= b
end
print(order(1, 2))
print(order("a", "b"))
print(order(2, 2))

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- shapes the printer turns back into source sugar
local Shapes = {}
Shapes.util = {}

function Shapes.util.area(w, h)
	return w * h
end

function Shapes.new(kind, w, h)
	return setmetatable({ kind = kind, w = w, h = h }, { __index = Shapes })
end

function Shapes:describe()
	return self.kind .. " " .. Shapes.util.area(self.w, self.h)
end

local function parse(text)
	local n = tonumber(text)
	if n == nil then
		error("not a number: " .. text)
	end
	return n
end

local success, result = pcall(parse, "12")
print(success, result)
local okay, err = pcall(parse, "twelve")
print(okay, (string.gsub(err, "^.-: ", "")))

local items = { Shapes.new("square", 2, 2), Shapes.new("strip", 1, 9) }
for i, shape in ipairs(items) do
	print(i, shape:describe())
end

local totals = { a = 1 }
local keys = {}
for key, value in pairs(totals) do
	table.insert(keys, key .. "=" .. value)
end
print(table.concat(keys))

local name = items[3] and items[3].kind or "none"
print(name)

local x
if #items > 1 then
	x = "many"
else
	x = "few"
end
print(x)

-- shapes the new core used to refuse, mostly what -O2 inlining leaves behind

-- a local declared first, then a function that calls itself through it
local count = 0
local tick
tick = function(n)
	count += 1
	if n > 0 then
		tick(n - 1)
	end
end
tick(3)

-- a helper with a loop, inlined into a condition
local function isInside(node, kind)
	while node ~= nil do
		if node.kind == kind then
			return true
		end
		node = node.parent
	end
	return false
end
local tree = { kind = "leaf", parent = { kind = "quote", parent = { kind = "doc" } } }
local function check(start, kind)
	local found = start ~= nil
	if found and isInside(start, kind) then
		return "inside " .. kind
	end
	return "outside " .. kind
end

-- a helper with early returns and a local the next tests compare against
local A = { Asset = 1, Bundle = 2, Look = 3 }
local B = { GamePass = 4, Product = 5 }
local function isSupported(payload, requestType)
	if type(payload) == "table" then
		local kind = payload.kind
		if kind == A.Asset or kind == A.Bundle or kind == A.Look then
			return true

-- naming that leans on Roblox conventions, run against small stand-ins for the real APIs
local Class = {}
Class.__index = Class

function Class.new(x)
	local obj = setmetatable({ x = x }, Class)
	local other = setmetatable({ x = -x }, Class)
	obj.peer = other
	function obj.get()
		return obj.x + other.x
	end
	return obj
end

function Class:clone()
	local copy = setmetatable({ x = self.x }, Class)
	return copy
end

function Class:spawner()
	return function(n)
		local inner = setmetatable({ x = self.x + n }, Class)
		return inner
	end
end

local Sub = setmetatable({}, { __index = Class })
Sub.__index = Sub
function Sub.new(x)
	local obj = setmetatable(Class.new(x), Sub)
	obj.sub = true
	return obj
end

local function signal()
	local handlers = {}
	return {
		Connect = function(_, f)
			table.insert(handlers, f)
		end,
		Fire = function(_, ...)
			for _, f in handlers do
				f(...)
			end
		end,
	}
end

local Players = { PlayerAdded = signal(), Stepped = signal() }
local log = {}
local function onStep(t, dt)
	table.insert(log, t + dt)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	table.insert(log, plr .. " joined")
end)
Players.Stepped:Connect(onStep)
Players.PlayerAdded:Fire("luna")
Players.Stepped:Fire(1, 0.5)

local folder = {}
function folder:GetChildren()
	return { "a", "b", "c" }
end
for _, item in folder:GetChildren() do
	table.insert(log, item)
end
for index, item in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
	table.insert(log, index .. item)
end

local a, b = Class.new(2), Sub.new(5)
print(a.get(), a:clone().x, a:spawner()(3).x, b.sub, b.get(), table.concat(log, ","))

-- locals that are written inside a loop and read after it, or in a repeat's condition
do
	local function scan(s)
		local depth, out = 0, {}
		local i = 1
		while i <= #s do
			local c = string.sub(s, i, i)
			if c == "(" then
				depth += 1
			elseif c == ")" then
				depth -= 1
				if depth < 0 then
					return "unbalanced at " .. i
				end
			elseif c == "x" and depth == 0 then
				table.insert(out, i)
			else
				i += 1
				continue
			end
			i += 1
		end
		if depth ~= 0 then
			return "open"
		end
		return table.concat(out, ",")
	end
	print(scan("x(x)x"), scan("(()"), scan("())x"), scan(""))
end
do
	local fs = {}
	local i = 0
	repeat
		i += 1
		local x = i * 3
		table.insert(fs, function() return x end)
	until x > 10
	local r = {}
	for _, f in fs do table.insert(r, f()) end
	print(table.concat(r, ","))
	local function g(t)
		local n = 0
		repeat
			n += 1
			local v = t[n]
		until v == nil or v < 0
		return n
	end
	print(g({1, 2, -1, 5}), g({}))
end

-- naming hints: services, children, modules, instances
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local damageEvent = remotes:WaitForChild("Damage")
local config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config"))

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

local marker = Instance.new("Part")
marker.Anchored = true
marker.CanCollide = false
marker.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
marker.Parent = workspace

local started = tick()
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		marker.Position = character:GetPivot().Position + Vector3.new(0, config.MarkerHeight, 0)
	end
	if tick() - started > config.Lifetime then
		marker:Destroy()
	end
end)

damageEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(amount, source)
	print(("took %d damage from %s"):format(amount, source.Name))
end)

-- work that never shows up in print: globals written and removed, a library table extended,
-- tables changed through metamethods and table.insert/remove, coroutines resumed for their side
-- effects, and what the chunk returns. Only what's left behind tells a right decompile from a
-- wrong one, so the result has to be graded on that too
registry = {}
local log = {}

local function track(t, name)
	return setmetatable({}, {
		__index = t,
		__newindex = function(_, k, v)
			table.insert(log, name .. "." .. tostring(k))
			rawset(t, k, v)
		end,
	})
end

local config = track({}, "config")
config.speed = 16
config.jump = 50
config.speed += 4

for i = 1, 5 do
	if i % 2 == 0 then
		table.insert(registry, i * i)
	elseif i == 5 then
		registry.last = i
	end
end
table.remove(registry, 1)

function string.shout(s)
	return s:upper() .. "!"
end

counter = 0
local worker = coroutine.wrap(function()
	for _ = 1, 3 do
		counter += 1
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end)
worker()
worker()

temporary = true
temporary = nil

local swapped = { a = 1, b = 2 }
swapped.a, swapped.b = swapped.b, swapped.a
settings = { config = config, swapped = swapped, log = log }

print("done")
return #log, registry.last, ("hi"):shout()

-- tables, varargs, multiple returns and string building
local function pack(...)
	return { n = select("#", ...), ... }
end

local function minMax(...)
	local args = pack(...)
	local lo, hi = math.huge, -math.huge
	for i = 1, args.n do
		lo = math.min(lo, args[i])
		hi = math.max(hi, args[i])
	end
	return lo, hi
end

local settings = {
	volume = 0.8,
	keybinds = { jump = "Space", sprint = "LeftShift" },
	tags = { "fast", "quiet" },
	[10] = "ten",
}

local lo, hi = minMax(4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42)
local summary = `range {lo}..{hi}, volume {settings.volume * 100}%`
print(summary, #settings.tags, settings.keybinds.jump, settings[10])

local parts = {}
for name, key in pairs(settings.keybinds) do
	parts[#parts + 1] = name .. "=" .. key
end
table.sort(parts)
print(table.concat(parts, ", "):upper())

-- rosetta mutant mut1-13 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
print("m68421", goal)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
repeat
do
	self.size -= 1
end
until true
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-14 of nested_inlining: wrap closure
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local _ = (function()
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

-- rosetta mutant mut1-17 of pathfinding: wrap for twice
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, 2 do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-90 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, delete, number, number
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)

	return grid, start, goal

	return y * 1000 + x

	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-147 of nested_inlining: wrap closure, flip, wrap for, wrap repeat
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
for _ = 1, 1 do
				return true
end
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end

	end
	return true

local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end

local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x  >=  2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-174 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, delete, number, number, wrap else
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end

	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]

	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil

-- rosetta mutant mut1-286 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat, wrap for
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
print("m68421", goal)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
repeat
do
	self.size -= 1
end
until true
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
for _ = 1, 1 do
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
end
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else

-- generic for without an iterator function: plain tables (array part, then hash part), __iter

local function keys(t)

	table.sort(out)

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end

flags.edge = false

	if type(names) == "table" then

for _ = 1, 1 do

	return "yes"

	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do

local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x  >=  2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-338 of nested_inlining: wrap closure, flip, wrap for, wrap repeat, wrap for twice, number, wrap else
-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
for _ = 1, 1 do
				return true
end
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
repeat
local vr = false

	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
until true
local _ = (function()
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
end)()
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x  >=  2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 255 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
for _ = 1, 2 do
			pick(x)
end
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)

		end

end

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1

	while i > 1 do

-- A tokenizer and recursive-descent parser for arithmetic, with variables and errors.

local function tokenize(source)
	local tokens = {}
	local i = 1
	while i <= #source do
		local c = source:sub(i, i)
		if c:match("%s") then
			i += 1
		elseif c:match("%d") then
for _ = 1, 1 do
			local number = source:match("^%d+%.?%d*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "number", value = tonumber(number) })
			i += #number
end
		elseif c:match("[%a_]") then
			local name = source:match("^[%a_][%w_]*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "name", value = name })
			i += #name
		elseif c:match("[%+%-%*/%^%(%)=]") then
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = c })
			i += 1
		else
			error(`unexpected character '{c}' at {i}`, 0)
		end
	end
	table.insert(tokens, { kind = "end" })

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}

	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {

	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)

	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if not ( self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority ) then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
repeat
do
	self.size -= 1
end
until true
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
for _ = 1, 1 do
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do

				table.insert(path, 1, current)

			end
			return path, visited

		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then

			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
local _ = (function()
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end

		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end
