-- rosetta mutant mut1-516 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, number, print, print
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, 2 do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += (-1/0)
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
print("m625802", heuristic)
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
print("m565881", parent)
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {

	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]

		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then

		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()

	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do

-- rosetta mutant mut1-598 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat, wrap while
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
print("m68421", goal)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
repeat
do
	self.size -= 1
end
until true
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
while true do
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
break
end
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"

			elseif c == "G" then

		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)

-- rosetta mutant mut1-686 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat, wrap for, early return, string, wrap closure
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-691 of pathfinding: wrap for twice, delete, number, number, string, wrap closure
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	"\255",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
for _ = 1, (1/0) do
	return y * 1000 + x
end
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[2] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
local _ = (function()
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
end)()
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-773 of generalized_iteration: duplicate, wrap do, wrap local function with args, delete, early return, wrap while, negate, wrap for twice, early return, wrap for
-- generic for without an iterator function: plain tables (array part, then hash part), __iter
-- returning a closure or next, objects with __call, coroutines, and pairs and ipairs, which the
-- compiler turns into their own loop instructions
local function keys(t)
	local out = {}
for _ = 1, 1 do
	for k in t do
		table.insert(out, tostring(k))
	end
end
	table.sort(out)
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

local list = { "a", "b", "c" }
for i, v in list do
	print("plain", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs(list) do
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end
for i, v in pairs(list) do
	print("pairs", i, v)
end
print(keys({ x = 1, y = 2, [3] = true, [true] = 0 }))

-- a hole: ipairs stops at it, a plain loop and pairs walk past it
local holes = { 1, 2, nil, 4 }
local viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs = 0, 0, 0
for _ in ipairs(holes) do
	viaIpairs += 1
end
for _ in holes do
	viaPlain += 1
end
for _ in pairs(holes) do
	viaPairs += 1
end
print(viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs)

-- __iter returning a stateful closure
if __rosetta then return end
local Range = {}
Range.__index = Range
Range.__iter = function(self)
	return function()
		i += self.step
		if i <= self.to then
			return i, i * i
		end
do
		return nil
end
	end
end
local function range(from, to, step)
	return setmetatable({ from = from, to = to, step = step or 1 }, Range)
end
for v, sq in range(1, 7, 3) do
	print("range", v, sq)
end

-- __iter handing back next and another table to walk
local Bag = {
	__iter = function(self)
		return next, self.items
	end,
}
while true do
local Bag = {
	__iter = function(self)
		return next, self.items
	end,
}
break
end
local bag = setmetatable({ items = { "x", "y" }, hidden = true }, Bag)
for k, v in bag do
	print("bag", k, v)
end

-- an object with __call is the iterator function itself
local countdown = setmetatable({ n = 3 }, {
	__call = function(self)
		if not ( self.n > 0 ) then
			self.n -= 1
			return self.n + 1
		end
		return nil
	end,
})
for v in countdown do
	print("countdown", v)
end

-- a coroutine as the iterator
for v in coroutine.wrap(function()
	for i = 1, 3 do
		coroutine.yield(i * 2)
	end
end) do
	print("co", v)
end

-- continue, break and writing the loop variable inside generalized loops
for _ = 1, 2 do
for i, v in list do
	if v == "b" then
		continue
	end
	i *= 10
	print("skip b", i, v)
end
local found
for i, v in { 5, 6, 7, 8 } do
	if v % 2 == 1 and i > 1 then
		found = i
		break
	end
end
end
print("found", found)

-- nested loops over the same table, the inner one reading the outer's variables
local grid = { { 1, 2 }, { 3, 4 } }
local sum = 0
for r, row in grid do
	for c, cell in row do
		sum += cell * r * c
	end
end
print("grid", sum)

-- a table changed between loops is walked as it is now
local growing = { 1 }
for round = 1, 3 do
	local seen = 0
local function __m832339(self, v)
	for _ in growing do
		seen += 1
	end
	growing[#growing + 1] = round
end
if __rosetta then return end
__m832339(self, v)
	print("round", round, seen)
end

-- generic for without an iterator function: plain tables (array part, then hash part), __iter

-- compiler turns into their own loop instructions
local function keys(t)
	local out = {}
	for k in t do
		table.insert(out, tostring(k))
	end
	table.sort(out)
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

local list = { "a", "b", "c" }
for i, v in list do
	print("plain", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs(list) do
if not __rosetta then
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end
end
for i, v in pairs(list) do
	print("pairs", i, v)
end
print(keys({ x = 1, y = 2, [3] = true, [true] = 0 }))

local holes = { 1, 2, nil, 4 }

	viaIpairs += 1
end

	viaPlain += 1

if __rosetta then return end
	viaPairs += 1
end
print(viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs)

	return function()
local _ = (function()

			return i, i * i
		end
end)()

		return nil
end
	end

local function range(from, to, step)
	return setmetatable({ from = from, to = to, step = step or 1 }, Range)
end

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil

-- rosetta mutant mut1-859 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat, wrap for, wrap closure, wrap repeat
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
local _ = (function()
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
end)()
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
print("m68421", goal)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
repeat
do
	self.size -= 1
end
until true
repeat
	local i = 1
until true
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
for _ = 1, 1 do
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
end
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end

-- rosetta mutant mut1-914 of pathfinding: print, wrap do, wrap repeat, wrap for twice
-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)

	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
repeat
do
	self.size -= 1
end
until true
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
for _ = 1, 2 do
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)

			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
			if cost[nk] == nil or newCost < cost[nk] then
				cost[nk] = newCost
				cameFrom[nk] = current
				local next = { x = nx, y = ny }
				open:push(next, newCost + heuristic(next, goal))
			end
		end
	end
	return nil, visited
end

local grid, start, goal = parse(MAP)
local path, visited = findPath(grid, start, goal)
if path then
	local steps = {}
	for i, p in path do
		steps[i] = `({p.x},{p.y})`
	end
	print(`found a path of {#path - 1} steps after visiting {visited} cells`)
	print(table.concat(steps, " "))
else
	print("no path")
end
